name: The Famiglia
address: 3 Kort St, Bergsig, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Family-run Italian café in Great Brak River serving authentic coffee, fresh pastries, and homemade Italian fare.
description_long:
Tucked away in the quiet suburb of Bergsig in Great Brak River, The Famiglia brings genuine Italian warmth to the Garden Route. This family-run café and food store is the kind of place where regulars are greeted by name and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee mingles with the scent of baked goods coming out of the oven.

The menu leans into Italian comfort food done right — think proper espresso, homemade pastries, and daily specials that reflect what's fresh and available. It's a relaxed, unpretentious spot where you can grab a quick coffee and cornetto on your way through, or settle in for a leisurely breakfast with the family. The attached food store stocks Italian imports and local products, making it easy to take a piece of the experience home.

With an impressive 4.9-star rating from locals who've made it their go-to, The Famiglia has quickly become a beloved fixture in Great Brak River. It's the sort of neighbourhood gem that reminds you good food doesn't need to shout — it just needs to be honest, homemade, and served with care.
